what: LODI — Longitudinal Dynamic Interaction Model for Microbiome Counts
title: LODI — Longitudinal Dynamic Interaction Model for Microbiome Counts
text: LODI fits Bayesian dynamic factor model longitudinal microbiome count data. observed counts modelled rounded multivariate log-normal kernel, within-subject temporal signal decomposed two interpretable pieces: per-feature drift term, given genotype-specific AR(1) process Dirichlet-process mixture prior initial baseline, shared cross-feature factor term, given static loading matrix (identified via standard lower-triangular constraint positive diagonal) paired AR(1) latent factor process. model returns time-indexed cross-feature covariance Σt=ΛΛ⊤+σt2IJ\Sigma_t = \Lambda \Lambda^\top + \sigma^2_t I_J cleanly separates individual taxon trajectories shared dynamics drive interactions. information, see paper: Zhang, Ok, Ni (submitted), “Bayesian Nonparametric Longitudinal Factor Model Microbiome Counts.” Contact: Shuangjie Zhang shuangjie.zhang@austin.utexas.edu.

code: library(LODI)  # 1. Simulate a small dataset from the LODI generative model sim <- simulate_lodi(N = 15, T = 5, J = 20, K = 3, seed = 1)  # 2. Fit the model with a short MCMC run fit <- lodi(sim$Y, K = 3, niter = 400, nburn = 200, thin = 2, seed = 1)  # 3. Summarise the posterior posterior_rho(fit)                          # shared-factor AR(1) coefficient Sigma_hat <- posterior_Sigma(fit, timepoint = 1)  # J x J covariance at t = 1

what: Fit the LODI dynamic factor model — lodi
title: Fit the LODI dynamic factor model — lodi
text: Runs LODI MCMC \(N \times T \times J\) array counts. Given observed counts, sampler jointly infers per-(subject, time) log sample-scale factor \(r_{}\), genotype-specific AR(1) per-feature drift \(\alpha_{ijt}\) (Dirichlet-process mixture prior initial baseline \(\alpha_{ij1}\)), shared cross-feature loading matrix \(\Lambda\) (identified via lower-triangular constraint positive diagonal), AR(1) latent factors \(\eta_{}\), per-time residual variance \(\sigma^2_t\).

title: Fit the LODI dynamic factor model — lodi
code: lodi(   Y,   K,   niter = 4000L,   nburn = 2000L,   thin = 1L,   L = 10L,   genotype = NULL,   seed = 1L )

title: Fit the LODI dynamic factor model — lodi
text: Y Integer array counts dimension \(N \times T \times J\) (subjects x timepoints x features). Missing values supported. K Integer, number latent factors used fitted model. niter Total number MCMC iterations. nburn Number initial iterations discarded burn-. thin Thinning interval: every thin-th post-burn-iteration retained. L Truncation level stick-breaking approximation Dirichlet-process mixture \(\alpha_{ij1}\). genotype Optional integer vector length \(N\) giving genotype/group label subject \(\{1, \dots, G\}\), used genotype-specific AR(1) coefficient \(\phi_g\). Default NULL places subjects single group. seed Integer random seed passed C++ sampler.

title: Fit the LODI dynamic factor model — lodi
text: list posterior draws elements Lambda array nkeep x J x K, factor loadings. eta array nkeep x T x K x N, latent factor scores. alpha array nkeep x N x T x J, per-feature drift trajectories. r array nkeep x N x T, sample-scale factors. sigma2 matrix nkeep x T, per-time residual variance. rho numeric vector nkeep, AR(1) coefficient factor process. phi_g matrix nkeep x G, genotype-specific drift AR(1) coefficients. V numeric vector nkeep, drift innovation variance. niter, nburn, thin, K, L sampler settings reference.

title: Simulate a longitudinal count table from the LODI generative model — simulate_lodi
text: Draws synthetic dataset matching "Simulation 1: matched truth" setting Zhang, Ok, Ni (submitted), "Bayesian Nonparametric Longitudinal Factor Model Microbiome Counts": rounded log-normal observation model, three-cluster Dirichlet-process mixture initial baselines, AR(1) per-feature drift, AR(1) shared factors lower-triangular identifiable loadings.

title: Simulate a longitudinal count table from the LODI generative model — simulate_lodi
code: simulate_lodi(   N = 20,   T = 7,   J = 30,   K = 3,   G = 1,   phi = 0.8,   V = 0.2,   rho = 0.7,   sigma2 = 0.5,   mu_cluster = c(-4, 2, 8),   w_cluster = c(0.5, 0.2, 0.3),   r_mean = 0,   r_sd = 1,   seed = 1L )

title: Simulate a longitudinal count table from the LODI generative model — simulate_lodi
text: N Number subjects. T Number timepoints. J Number features. K True number latent factors used generate data. G Number genotype groups (subjects split evenly). phi Per-feature AR(1) coefficient (shared across genotypes ). V Innovation variance drift process. rho AR(1) coefficient shared factor process. sigma2 Global residual variance log-latent. mu_cluster Length-3 vector DP-mixture cluster means \(\alpha_{ij1}\). w_cluster Length-3 vector DP-mixture cluster weights. r_mean, r_sd Mean sd per-(subject, time) intercept. seed Random seed.

title: Simulate a longitudinal count table from the LODI generative model — simulate_lodi
text: list elements Y integer array N x T x J, simulated counts. Y_star numeric array N x T x J, log-latent used generate counts (flooring). Lambda,eta,alpha,r parameters used generate data. genotype integer vector length N giving subject's genotype label \(\{1, ..., G\}\). Sigma_true array J x J x T, true within-time cross-feature covariance \(\Lambda\Lambda^\top + \sigma^2 \) timepoint. settings list simulation settings used.
